description: Viberate helps users search artists, tracks, labels, and festivals, then retrieve music analytics including rankings, audience breakdowns, historical metrics, and playlist placements, plus festival lineups.

defaultPrompt: What are Dua Lipa's latest streaming numbers across platforms?
Which festivals is Bad Bunny playing this summer?
Show me the top trending tracks on the Beatport techno chart this week.
interface.longDescription: Viberate helps users search artists, tracks, labels, and festivals, then retrieve music analytics including rankings, audience breakdowns, historical metrics, and playlist placements, plus festival lineups.

name: viberate-music-analytics

positive.description: Artist lookup and historical streaming metrics
positive.prompt: What are Dua Lipa's latest Spotify monthly listeners, and how have they changed over the past 3 months?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Dua Lipa to the correct artist, returns current profile/rank details, and reports Spotify listener (or related streaming) values over the requested period with date-keyed observations. Does not invent numbers when the API returns no data.

positive.prompt: Where are Dua Lipa's Spotify listeners concentrated by city? Show the top cities.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Dua Lipa, then returns a ranked list of cities with Spotify listener audience values (and percentage/change fields when available). Treats each audience metric separately and does not mix incompatible audience metrics.

positive.description: Track search, details, and Spotify playlist placements
positive.prompt: Find Dua Lipa's track Levitating and show which Spotify playlists it appears on, sorted by playlist followers.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Levitating to the correct track and artist, returns track metadata/links/ranks, and lists Spotify playlists containing the track with follower counts and position/date-added when available.

positive.prompt: Look up Atlantic Records and show its top artists by streams on that label.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Atlantic Records, returns label metadata (name, country/genres when available), and a ranked roster of label-associated artists with performance stats. Clarifies that label-associated streams are not the artist's full-catalog total.

positive.prompt: Find Tomorrowland in Belgium and show its lineup of performing artists.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Tomorrowland (Belgium), returns festival metadata such as location, dates, genres and size/rank when available, and lists participating artists by name/UUID. Does not invent set times, stages, or performance dates that the lineup tool does not provide.

negative.prompt: Write original song lyrics about heartbreak in the style of a pop ballad.
Buy me two VIP tickets to Tomorrowland this summer and check out with my card.

negative.description: Music theory tutoring outside data tools
negative.prompt: Explain the circle of fifths and help me transpose this chord progression from C major to E major.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It provides read-only music analytics lookups.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of Viberate music analytics in ChatGPT. Search artists, tracks, labels, and festivals and get rankings, audience breakdowns, historical metrics, playlist placements, and festival lineups.
